how_to_steps: Clone the ACI repo and read the README
Open Claude Code/Cursor/Antigravity in the directory and paste the setup system prompt (reads brain/, CLAUDE.md, bootstrap-interview.md)

Answer the interview in phases: Phase 1 Archetype & Identity (Creator, Busy Operator, Freelancer, Founder, Owner/Utility); Phase 2 Offer, Audience & Traction (business model, target persona, daily headaches, dream outcome); Phase 3 Voice Calibration & Anti-Sludge (paste 1-3 writing samples, list pet peeves and buzzwords to avoid); Phase 4 Workflow Mapping & Engine Selection (select active engines, supply a system example); Phase 5 Auto-Synthesis & Workspace Calibration
AI auto-populates brain/identity.md, brain/voice-and-tone.md, brain/trip-and-wire(?), and agent folders with instructions and guardrails
Then just ask: 'create a new email on this topic for this audience'; the LLM routes to the right agent folder, follows its guard rails, and executes through MCP/API connectors
